description: Add an empty sheet at the end of a session's workbook and make it the active sheet (the one unqualified refs like "B4" point to). Only for sessions created blank (create_session with no file); on an imported workbook it fails, so work in its existing sheets with set_inputs instead. To retitle a sheet use rename_sheet; to remove one use delete_sheet. Returns {sheet_index, sheet_name, sheet_count}.

name.description: Name for the new sheet tab, e.g. "Assumptions"

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: add_sheet
title: Add sheet
